from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted classification and metadata for a single judgment document."""
    title: str = Field(description="The official title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action: str = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action stated in the document, e.g. 'Administrative Compensation', 'Civil Execution Objection'")
    case_type: str = Field(description="The broad legal nature of the case, e.g., 'Administrative', 'Civil', 'Criminal'")
    compensation_nature: str | None = Field(description="The nature of any financial relief mentioned, e.g., 'Administrative Compensation', 'Administrative Indemnification', 'National Compensation'")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentRecord]
